mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES rebounded 15.4 points in the latest week (from -37.3 to -21.9), signalling that commuting routines are resuming; returning commuters restore weekday footfall in retail corridors, lifting RETAIL_REC above its -29.0 trailing four-week mean within one week.
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES rose from -37.3 at t-1w to -21.9 at t-0w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's forward 28-day mean is below its trailing 28-day mean (-29.0) in weeks where WORKPLACES rises at least 10 points.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT recovering from -38.9 to -31.6 while GROCERY_PHARM reaches 0.0 shows non-essential out-of-home trips resuming; the joint movement of transit ridership and grocery normality multiplies retail visits, raising RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT improves more than 5 points week-on-week while GROCERY_PHARM is above -1.0
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT improved 7.3 points from t-1w to t-0w
failure_condition: When TRANSIT improves more than 5 points with GROCERY_PHARM above -1.0, the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean fails to exceed the trailing mean.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL stays 9 to 13 points above baseline in every observed week while RETAIL_REC is pinned near -27, indicating that home-confinement behaviour persists; continued elevated residential time displaces discretionary retail trips, pushing RETAIL_REC lower over four weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL remains above +8.0 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:RESIDENTIAL averaged +10.6 across the four observed weeks
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above -29.0 whenever RESIDENTIAL exceeds +8.0 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: A week-on-week WORKPLACES drop greater than 10 points, as with the 14.4-point fall into the -37.3 reading at t-1w, marks a restriction shock that removes commuters from retail districts; once crossed, the threshold cuts RETAIL_REC in the following week.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES falls more than 10 points week-on-week
evidence_refs: fact:WORKPLACES fell 14.4 points between t-2w and t-1w
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC in the week after a WORKPLACES drop greater than 10 points is equal to or higher than the week before the drop.

mechanism_narrative: PARKS swung from -10.4 to -24.9 and stayed near -20, a seasonal winter collapse in outdoor activity that removes strolling-driven spillover into nearby retail; persistence of this pattern depresses RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS remains below -15 for two consecutive weeks
evidence_refs: fact:PARKS fell 14.5 points between t-3w and t-2w and never recovered above -18
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is above -29.0 while PARKS stays below -15 for two consecutive weeks.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM returning to 0.0 while RETAIL_REC sits near -28 shows spending concentrated in essentials; the widening gap between essential and discretionary trips crowds out retail browsing, driving RETAIL_REC lower over two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:GROCERY_PHARM is 27.9 points above RETAIL_REC at t-0w
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean exceeds the trailing mean whenever the GROCERY_PHARM minus RETAIL_REC gap exceeds 25 points.

mechanism_narrative: Under tightening restrictions, TRANSIT declines lead retail declines by about one week because transit riders are the marginal retail visitors; in that regime a TRANSIT reading below -35 predicts a lower RETAIL_REC mean over the next four weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:TRANSIT hit -38.9 at t-1w, the same week WORKPLACES fell to -37.3
failure_condition: In tightening-restriction weeks with TRANSIT below -35, the forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not lower than the trailing 28-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: RETAIL_REC has flattened near -27 to -28 for two consecutive weeks while TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM both improved in the latest week; this joint stabilisation marks the mobility trough, so RETAIL_REC mean-reverts upward over the next two weeks.
evidence_refs: fact:RETAIL_REC stayed within 1.0 point across t-1w and t-0w
failure_condition: Forward 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is below -29.0 despite a flat RETAIL_REC reading combined with improving TRANSIT and GROCERY_PHARM.
